title: Report (runs/<run-id>/report.json)
description: The three parts of every report: one sentence, an optional table of at most five rows of three cells, one Next line (the FAIL report of promote may carry a fourth part, the suggestion, between the table and the Next line). report.md is rendered from this by renderReport() in scripts/lib/report.mjs and linted before it is written.

demo.description: True: report.md starts the sentence with 'Demo · '.

sentence.description: One line, without the Demo prefix.

header.description: The header row of the table. The third cell is empty for a two-column table.

rows.description: Body rows of exactly three cells (the third is empty in a two-column table). Left out when there is nothing to count.

extra.description: Only the FAIL report of promote has it: the suggestion (a sentence, the reason for it and the rule to copy), a fourth part rendered between the table and the Next line. Left out in every other report.
